w11-sofia-red-shoes.observed_description: Sofia (curly dark hair, warm brown skin, blue blazer over a white blouse) stands in a shoe store and holds two red shoes, one in each hand, side by side; a pair of black shoes stands on the wooden shelf beside her.
w11-sofia-red-shoes.note: Usable: she holds a pair of red shoes, clearly two, so the red ones and not the red one; the black pair stays beside her for the black ones. An edit of the 2.10 photo that showed one red shoe.
